title: Trump Tower Jeddah | Seafront Residences by DarGlobal
text: TRUMP TOWER JEDDAH. SAUDI ARABIA. Trump Tower Jeddah is a 47-floor Trump-branded seafront residential tower on the Jeddah Corniche, developed by DarGlobal. Apartments and penthouses range from 70 to 365 sqm across one- to four-bedroom configurations, all with uninterrupted Red Sea views. The tower includes the Trump Private Club, offering residents fine dining, a gym, pool, cigar lounge, and 24/7 concierge. PROPERTY TYPE: Seafront Residences. UNIT TYPE: 1, 2, 3, 4 Bedroom Apartments & 3, 4 Bedroom Penthouses. LOCATION: Jeddah Corniche, Saudi Arabia. NUMBER OF FLOORS: 47. AREA (SQM): 70 to 365. FEATURES & AMENITIES: Uninterrupted Sea Views; Prime Location On the Corniche; Architectural Landmark; Trump Private Club; 24/7 Concierge; Meeting Rooms; Cigar Lounge; Fine Dining; Pool; Kids Pool; Jacuzzi; Gym; Yoga Zone. PRIME LOCATION: Located along Jeddah's Red Sea coastline, with easy access to the marina, the Formula 1 racetrack, and the iconic fountain. FAQ: When will Trump Tower Jeddah be completed? Completion is scheduled for December 2029. The project is under development by DarGlobal. Buyers can contact the sales team directly for current availability, payment plan structure, and brochure download. Is Trump Tower Jeddah developed by the Trump Organization? No. Trump Tower Jeddah is owned and developed by DarGlobal Holdings Real Estate, which uses the Trump name and mark under a licensing agreement. The Trump Organization is not the owner, developer, or seller of the property. Disclaimer: Trump Tower Jeddah is not owned, developed or sold by The Trump Organization or any of their current or former principals or affiliates; DarGlobal Holdings Real Estate uses the Trump name and mark under license, which license may be terminated or revoked according to its terms.
